nom: Curology Clear Pimple Patch Clusters for Face

avis.titre: Works the BEST please use they deserve all credit!
avis.texte: Freaking awesome this whole pimple situation is all gone in like 30 to 60 minutes !
Bought these, unfortunately my face is too sensitive for them, but they’re pretty good quality.
Holy!! It works! Been using this for a year. Still using it!I have stubborn pimples sometimes but I just keep using it longer until it’s gone.
I like these but are kinda expensive. I liked how these were bigger. They did stay on even if I applied moisturizer thought which is great!
Amazing little stickers that help heal sore and pimples! I was amazed!
I love these patches, they work so well and cover a larger area
Love this brand!! Works great on my chin and nose. Sucks us lots of oil and works wonders in pimples with a whitehead!

Curology crushed the pimple patch game. these work so quickly and get so much out of your pores! Leaves your face feeling so smooth and clean after one use. Pros: - do not hurt when peeling off of your face like other brands have in the past to me - the size of them works great for a bunch of problem areas where you need oil/pores cleaned out - do not feel them on your face if sleeping with them on - i have used these for 3hours up to 8 hours and even for the shorter time frames they still pull a ton out - do not irritate the skin (i have super sensitive skin) - They do not get hard and “crunchy” like other brands Cons: - not one complaint about these at all!

These patches are good at covering a larger area of pimples clustered together. I feel it sticks better to the affected area, since it can cover all of them more completely and stick to the surrounding skin. It’s a large size and I find it’s best for wearing overnight when you can have it on undisturbed for hours. Sticks well and covers more surface!

I really liked these patches. They stick well and wouldn’t come off. They’re useful for larger areas and you can see the gunk that comes out of the skin which is cool. They’re pretty thin and comfortable to wear as well.
These patches are Great with my cluster blemishes. They fit on my chin or side of my cheek that gets alot in a lil spot.
Be careful is you have sensitive skin. Left an irritated mark. I had a blemish on my upper arms and back and left a welt on all 3 spots.

I like these acne patches so far. I put them on at night since they can stay on for up to 6 hours. I haven’t seen any noticeable change on my chin so far after use. I’m hoping they start to work eventually.

I loved these way better than the spot patches merely because they are more catered to breakouts and cover more surface area atonce time. I left it on for 24hrs to ensure that all of the oil and gunk was removed.
